h: Natasha Osawaru's video of Peter Obi sparks reactions ahead of 2027
p: A video of social media personality Natasha Osawaru featuring Peter Obi is drawing reactions online as the 2027 race heats up. Supporters and critics have been trading comments about the clip. The NDC presidential candidate's camp has not been reported to have commented on it.
more: The clip is circulating widely on social media.
Obi's supporters have been sharing it as an endorsement of his campaign.
